source_item.title: Netherlands NIS2 Transposition (Cyberbeveiligingswet) Enters Into Force
source_item.description: The Dutch Senate approved the Cyberbeveiligingswet (transposing NIS2) and the Wet weerbaarheid kritieke entiteiten (transposing CER) on July 7, 2026. The Cyberbeveiligingswet enters into force on August 15, 2026, establishing a three-tier regulatory regime; formal notification of transposition to the European Commission had not yet been submitted as of the Senate vote.
source_item.impact: Dutch entities in scope of NIS2 must comply with new cybersecurity and incident-reporting obligations from August 15, 2026.
